goal: Smoke-test workspace API adapter tools against the local mock promotions feed.

milestones.title: Promotions snapshot (API proxy)
milestones.goal: Call the workspace API proxy `menu_promotions_mock_api` (HTTP GET) to fetch the JSON promotions feed. Summarize every promotion in the Data tab: for each item include title, discount percent, valid-from and valid-to dates, and channels. If the tool fails, write a short explanation in the Data tab.
milestones.data:
## Promotions snapshot

_This section will be filled when you click Run — the agent should call `menu_promotions_mock_api` then save Markdown here._

passCriteria.requirement: Data tab mentions at least one promotion title that appears in the JSON feed (e.g. Ramadan evening tea set, Weekday lunch pairing, or Happy hour).
Data tab includes a validity window (from–to dates) for at least one promotion.
Data tab states the discount or offer terms for at least one promotion (e.g. percent off).
